excerpts.content:
Slightly off topic but not really...

What is the most up to date client for `ethstats.net`?

The most popular repo hasn't been updated in 4 years. I know it's built into Geth and Nethermind, but I'm curious if someone is maintaining a client for it.

https://github.com/cubedro/eth-netstats <- Old

excerpts.author: _0xuser
excerpts.content:
> Hi everyone, I have a legit questions about a potential miners power-exploit with the DeFi worlds. Would love to hear your thoughts in case I am mis-understanding something..
<@184800644266196992> what you describes is called front-running. Yes, it happens. The way to avoid it is to set a maximum price variation (1inch allows you to do that)
The reason you don't see a tx in etherscan is probably because they are internal tx, not normal tx. You have to click on the internal txs tab
